message: Any New Staff viewer is taken for the questionnaire's staff member, so when both spouses are new staff the non-applicant spouse sees their own photo on the applicant's card and a wrong toggle label.
dismissalDetail: MPDX-10399 adds an API field saying which questionnaire person the viewer is, and replaces this staff group guess

message: An applicant whose GetUser group is null or not New Staff is treated as the spouse, so they lose their own avatar and may see a 'View Yourself' toggle on their own card.
dismissalDetail: MPDX-10399 adds an API field saying which questionnaire person the viewer is, and replaces this staff group guess

message: No test checks that a New Staff viewer's avatar disappears after toggling to the spouse card, so removing the showsStaffMember guard would pass every test.
dismissalDetail: MPDX-10399 adds an API field saying which questionnaire person the viewer is, and replaces this staff group guess

message: The hook ignores userPending and userError, so an unknown viewer is treated as the spouse and a blank spouse name shows 'View Yourself' while loading or after a GetUser failure.
dismissalDetail: MPDX-10399 adds an API field saying which questionnaire person the viewer is, and replaces this staff group guess

message: The spouse card joins spouseFirstName with the applicant's lastName, so a spouse with a different surname gets the wrong full name.
dismissalDetail: the spouse card name came from the applicant last name before this PR, worth its own ticket

message: The new hook has no colocated useStaffCardViewer.test.ts, which the repo's standards ask for on every new hook.
dismissalDetail: the hook is rewritten in MPDX-10399 around an API viewer field, and gets its own test file there

message: The hook guesses the viewer from a staff group even though person numbers available client-side could identify the viewer exactly.
dismissalDetail: MPDX-10399 adds an API field saying which questionnaire person the viewer is, and replaces this staff group guess

message: Viewer identity reads inNsGoalCalcIneligibleGroup, an eligibility flag for another tool, so changes to that tool's eligible groups would silently change this card.
dismissalDetail: MPDX-10399 adds an API field saying which questionnaire person the viewer is, and replaces this staff group guess

message: A spouse viewer never sees their own avatar on their own card even though data.user.avatar is their photo.
dismissalDetail: MPDX-10399 adds an API field saying which questionnaire person the viewer is, and replaces this staff group guess

message: The new otherIsViewer comment is vaguer than the removed one, which spelled out both cases of the equality.
dismissalDetail: the hook comment covers both cases in one line
